listings.name: Gustav
listings.description: A French-inspired bistro and cocktail bar by the Cascade, opened in 2023. Its menu runs from smashed burgers to the Gustav Pan, with a sauce of 30 herbs.

listings.name: PAUL
listings.description: Armenia’s first café of the French bakery PAUL, in an 1884 building on Abovyan Street, open from breakfast.

listings.name: Sherep
listings.description: By Republic Square, where the old Armenia café stood: an open kitchen and a tonir, and dishes from many countries rather than one.

photos.title: File:Lavash baking in a restaurant (Yerevan) June 2023.jpg

listings.name: Lavash
listings.description: Traditional Armenian dishes, with lavash from its own tonir, and known for its breakfasts.

listings.name: Dolmama
listings.description: Armenian cooking, old and new, in rooms full of art and a courtyard under the vines, with its signature dolma.

listings.name: Tavern Yerevan
listings.description: Armenian dishes from old recipes and new, with bread from the tonir. One of four Tavern Yerevan restaurants.

listings.name: Charentsi 28
listings.description: Dishes from around the world, from Western Armenian manti to Mediterranean, Indian and Mexican, in a house with a courtyard.

listings.name: Abovyan 12
listings.description: The Dalan art gallery’s courtyard restaurant, with Armenian dishes and many Armenian wines and brandies.

listings.name: Caucasian Captive
listings.description: Themed on the 1967 comedy Kidnapping, Caucasian Style, with bronze figures of its three heroes at the door and Caucasian dishes inside.

listings.name: Dargett Craft Beer
listings.description: A craft brewery’s own pub, with its beers on tap, burgers and tarte flambée, and a terrace.
